purpose: Resolve the post-V5 C1 security handoff projection and authorize bounded evidence-only mechanical expansion after the mixed C1 V2 result. This V6 is an authoritative semantic basis for later acyclic evidence descendants; it is not an expanded registry, correction map, exact-byte owner ratification, concurrence acceptance, product authorization, or fixture implementation.

exact_existing_inputs.role: V5 exact-byte owner ratification and C1-only authorization
C1 V2 migration acceptance of the V5 coordinate
C1 V2 security rejection of the V5 coordinate

mixed_c1_v2_disposition.migration: The exact C1 V2 migration acceptance remains immutable historical evidence for the V5 coordinate but does not carry forward as acceptance of any expanded registry, later correction map, later owner receipt, or rerun C1 coordinate.
mixed_c1_v2_disposition.security: The exact C1 V2 security rejection remains immutable defect evidence and stops C1. It cannot be waived, edited into acceptance, or treated as acceptance of later descendants.
mixed_c1_v2_disposition.rule: Because one required C1 role rejected and the descendant bytes and counts must change, both migration and security must rerun fresh after new descendants receive a separate exact-byte Product Owner ratification.

ratified_q14_q16_decisions.title: Ordinary post-commit handoff transport failure projection
ratified_q14_q16_decisions.decision: When the credential mutation is already committed but the one-time handoff transport fails ordinarily, return the existing committed nonsecret mutation and result coordinates with secret_revealed=false. Do not return an error envelope for the ordinary transport failure.
mandatory_disposition: discard and never serialize, log, persist, echo, hash into content-bearing evidence, or rethrow any transport exception text containing secret, locator, path, pipe, native message, stack, SQL, or implementation detail
persist only content-free failed or ambiguous handoff evidence bound to the already-committed mutation and result coordinates
erase the secret bytes after the one permitted delivery attempt
do not overwrite the committed credential or locator
do not perform a second credential mutation
do not re-reveal the secret through result replay, evidence, logs, diagnostics, or artifacts
ordinary delivery or transport failure is not GKOS_P6_SECRET_EXPOSURE
ratified_q14_q16_decisions.separate_exposure_rule: Only an independently proven actual exposure uses a distinct deterministic GKOS_P6_SECRET_EXPOSURE leaf and the existing six-field content-free error envelope. The ordinary-failure leaf and proven-exposure leaf are separate canonical cases and may not be alternatives under one ID.
ratified_q14_q16_decisions.affected_prior_fixture: REDACTION-HANDOFF-ERROR-001 must be replaced or narrowed in later evidence so its ordinary-failure case has exactly this committed nonsecret result and its actual-exposure case is separate.

ratified_q14_q16_decisions.title: Evidence-only mechanical expansion authority
ratified_q14_q16_decisions.decision: Authorize the bounded source-controlled evidence expansion BCI-MECH-001 through BCI-MECH-006. This authority applies only to new detached registry, correction-map, validation, and exact-byte owner-ratification evidence descendants; it does not authorize product contract or fixture regeneration or implementation.

mechanical_inventory.rule: Remove modal may language. A positively qualified handoff completes exactly once under the existing nonsecret result rule. A request whose final gate wins publishes its already-authorized result; later disable or revoke governs only later work. Preserve each existing ID where no split is required.

Materialize locator and pipe handoff schedules separately where physical schedules differ, and materialize credential.issue and credential.rotate replay and failure schedules separately. Preserve a current canonical ID for exactly one source-controlled branch and allocate distinct additional IDs for every other branch without changing the named eight-ID subtotal.

Materialize backward and forward clock divergence separately; principal, session, policy, and recovery binding loss separately; and every claimed former reference or snapshot state separately while preserving Q2 restart precedence and byte-identical GKOS_P6_REQUEST_STALE_AUTHORITY.

Materialize every error-code instance as its own executable leaf or an explicitly closed parameterization counted as separate executable cases; materialize precommit and postcommit retention crashes separately; and materialize every named retention anchor crash cut separately.

Expand every omitted-versus-null, field-specific, physical-protection, malformed-token, and noncanonical-encoding negative so one executable leaf changes exactly one named field or physical condition and has one exact schedule and result.

After Q14 and BCI-MECH-001 through BCI-MECH-005 are materialized, recompute canonical IDs, additional and overall counts, all 16 family totals, aliases, raw hashes, byte lengths, and internal digests; regenerate only later acyclic evidence descendants and obtain a new exact-byte owner ratification before C1 reruns.

count_rule.rule: Do not predetermine, target-fit, or preserve 265 by collapsing cases. The actual final counts are the mechanically derived totals after every authorized leaf is materialized, deduplicated, sorted, family-counted, and validated.

ratified_q14_q16_decisions.title: Noncarrying migration acceptance and fresh C1 rerun
ratified_q14_q16_decisions.decision: The C1 V2 migration acceptance is historical and noncarrying because the registry and later evidence coordinate must change. After the expanded evidence descendants are complete and a separate Product Owner receipt ratifies their exact existing bytes, rerun both fresh zero-contribution C1 roles: migration and security.
required_sequence: new mechanically expanded registry evidence descendant implementing Q14 and BCI-MECH-001 through BCI-MECH-005 with BCI-MECH-006 exact accounting
new correction-map evidence descendant binding only already-existing immutable parents
separate exact-byte Product Owner ratification receipt for the completed descendant coordinate
fresh independent zero-contribution C1 migration review
fresh independent zero-contribution C1 security review
ratified_q14_q16_decisions.c1_acceptance_rule: Both fresh roles must unconditionally accept the same exact newly ratified coordinate. Neither the old migration acceptance nor old security rejection carries as a new verdict.
ratified_q14_q16_decisions.post_c1_rule: This V6 does not authorize C2 or C3. After both fresh C1 roles accept, preserve their receipts and return for an explicit next-wave authorization.

source_controlled_semantics_preserved.q1_q13: All Q1 through Q13 decisions ratified through V3, V4, and V5 remain unchanged except that the reviewed 265-case fixture coordinate is historical and its descendant counts must be mechanically recomputed under Q15.
source_controlled_semantics_preserved.r01_r15: All corrected R01 through R15 semantic selections remain unchanged, including R06 as an 18-case subtotal rather than an overall total, R07 restart cursor invalidation, and R15 adapter-dependent mapping deferral.
source_controlled_semantics_preserved.dc01_dc13: All D015-DC01 through D015-DC13 semantic corrections remain; DC06 accounting is recomputed from expanded deterministic leaves rather than preserving the invalid 265 total.
source_controlled_semantics_preserved.public_surface: The mechanical expansion does not change the 67 official MCP vector IDs or valid wire semantics, 53-code registry membership, seven required public tools, 16 tables, 32 operations, or 24 owner-only operations.

acyclic_descendant_rule.rule: Every new evidence descendant binds only exact immutable parent files that already exist when the descendant is created. This V6 intentionally does not identify, reserve, predict, or bind any later registry, map, ratification-receipt, or concurrence hash or byte length.
acyclic_descendant_rule.prior_bytes: V5, C1 V2 migration, C1 V2 security, and every earlier D0-15 record remain immutable historical inputs and must not be edited in place.
acyclic_descendant_rule.byte_change_effect: Any changed descendant byte invalidates only dependent later receipts; it does not rewrite or mutate an ancestor.

authority_boundary.rule: Authority is limited to detached evidence-only mechanical expansion and preparation of later exact-byte owner-ratification evidence. No review wave restarts and no product or repository mutation occurs from this V6.
